whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Pizza Enterprises,

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order booking, bestselling menu showcase, aur instant location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://pizza-enterprises-demo.arclane.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Pizza Enterprises team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your 4.9★ rating, bestselling pizza menu showcase, and direct WhatsApp ordering for your customers in Bihta. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu prices aur real photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
